name: @agentic-toolkit/api-explorer
description: Reusable, authed "try-it-out" endpoint panel for agentic-web-toolkit consumers — spec-generated endpoint metadata plus a theme-aware React panel that documents one REST endpoint (URL, params, request/response schemas, errors, CRUD-family siblings) and calls it with the logged-in user's credentials.
comment:exports: `development` → src for `next dev` (HMR, no build/restart); prod skips it → dist. Mirrors the @agenticdevelopertoolkit/ui + @agentic-toolkit/auth convention. `./generated/endpoints.generated` is a deliberate subpath export kept OFF the main barrel (see src/index.ts) — it exists only so the monorepo's drift test (websites/shared/api-explorer's src/__tests__/endpoints.test.ts, which stays monorepo-side to read openapi.json) can import the generated maps directly. `./lib/getEndpoint` and `./lib/highlight` are preserved-import subpaths (see the matching `external` entries + comment in tsup.config.ts): both hold module-level cache state and are consumed by the client barrel AND the server entry, which this package deliberately builds as two separate chunk graphs — so each needs importing by package path, not relatively, to keep one shared copy instead of a silent per-graph fork.
